'''Dundela Football Club''', nicknamed "'''The Duns'''" is a semi-professional, [[Northern Ireland|Northern Irish]] [[Association football|football]] club from [[Belfast]], currently playing in the [[NIFL Championship]], and plays its home matches at Wilgar Park. The club's colours are green and white. The home kit has green shirts, green shorts and green socks, whilst the away kit is all red."}}
